summary: hire walks the price-ranked Taskers until one has an open slot on the requested date, and caps against TaskRabbit's quoted hourly total when it exceeds the modeled all-in rate.
reason: Recommendations for a date still list Taskers who are booked that day, so taking the cheapest one blocked every booking beyond a day or two out. TaskRabbit's trust-and-safety fee can run above the modeled percentage, which let the cap underestimate the charge.
validated_outcome: Live: four requested dates each resolved to a Tasker free on that exact date. For one Tasker, TaskRabbit quoted $38.13/hr against a modeled $37.35/hr.
